[.verse-line]
[.i263]##{nbsp}##She that will eat her breakfast in her bed,
[.i268]##{nbsp}##And spend the morn in dressing of her head,
[.i268]##{nbsp}##And sit at dinner like a maiden bride,
[.i268]##{nbsp}##And talk of nothing all day but of pride;
[.i265]##{nbsp}##God in his mercy may do much to save her,
[.i259]##{nbsp}##But what a case is he in that shall have her.
